note: Global site header -- renders: skip link, GitHub logo, fixed navigation menu (Product/Solutions/Marketplace/Explore/Pricing), search trigger, Sign in/Sign up CTAs, and appearance settings
Repository tab navigation -- renders: Code, Issues, Pull requests, Actions, Projects, Wiki, Security, Insights (fixed operator vocabulary)
Repository action buttons -- renders: Watch, Fork, Star (fixed operator vocabulary; counts are handled by deterministic pass)
Issue status label -- renders: Closed/Open (fixed operator vocabulary)
Signed-out banner -- renders: Sign up prompt and fixed marketing copy
Issue metadata sidebar -- renders: fixed section headers (Assignees, Labels, Projects, Milestone, Development, Participants, Options) and empty states; user-generated values are masked by default
Site footer -- renders: GitHub logo, copyright, and fixed navigation links (Terms, Privacy, Security, Status, Docs, Contact, etc.)
